Maya Nguyen: Quick heads-upHelixCare onboarding revealed a few product/billing pain points. Need fast capture for Product.
Jamal Ortiz: Notes from call: billing per-route mismatch, stale embeddings hurting search, dashboard times out on long-range exports.
Otis Lane: Drop raw quotes and I'll put them into the CSV schema.
Maya Nguyen: Raw quotes below bucket and severity please. If >1 high-impact mark renewal risk and ping Priya.
```
"We can't reconcile cost per route numbers differ from invoice" Jaime (Billing)
"Search misses new SKUs embeddings seem stale" Rachel (Catalog)
"Dashboard times out when exporting 90 days" Sam (Ops)
"Would like per-env toggle for embedding refresh cadence" Jaime
```
Priya Shah: What's the ARR? Prioritization depends on contract size.
Jamal Ortiz: Mid-market ~45k ARR; onboarding ~3w delayed. Jaime called renewal concern.
Maya Nguyen: Renewal risk = medium-high. Short-term: UI toggle/workaround for billing + embeddings refresh toggle. Long-term: reconciliation view and scheduled embedding refresh.
Otis Lane: CSV schema ready (customer,user_quote,theme,severity,impact,suggested_owner). Jamal can you map and upload?
Jamal Ortiz: Uploaded sample to #cs-uploads. Sample rows:
```csv
HelixCare,"We can't reconcile cost per route",billing,high,"Finance can't forecast","Product: billing-ux"
HelixCare,"Embeddings are stale; search misses",embeddings,medium,"Search relevance down","Eng-ml"
HelixCare,"Dashboard times out on 90-day export",performance,low,"Observed at peak","Eng-infra"
```
Priya Shah: If I get top 3 themes + owners by EOD I'll slot a lightweight ask into roadmap sync.
Maya Nguyen: Plan: Jamal finishes CSV, Otis drafts workaround one-pager, Priya assesses priority. I'll notify CSMs to surface anything else.
feedback-bot: Ticket created PROD-FB-5678 (HelixCare onboarding capture)
Otis Lane: I'll own the workaround PR.
Jamal Ortiz: Happy to schedule 15-min follow with Jaime for clarifications.
Priya Shah: Acknowledged. Will post priority + effort estimate by 17:30.
Maya Nguyen: Closing thread; will update renewal tracker after roadmap sync.
